newsitem.title: HONG KONG: New World down on placement, tone firm.
newsitem.headline: New World down on placement, tone firm.

text.p: Shares of New World Development Co Ltd fell HK$0.60 or 1.58 percent to HK$37.40 in early trade after they resumed trading of Friday following a placement announcement, but brokers expected the shares to remain steady to firmer in the near run.
"A HK$0.90 gap between the placement and trading price triggered the early selling," a dealing director at a regional brokerage said.
New World's controlling shareholder on Thursday agreed to place out 75 million existing shares at HK$37.10 and subscribe to the same amount of new shares at the same price.

However, brokers said they expected the shares to have a limited downside in view of the good response to the share placement, which also resulted in the company having a lower debt-to-equity ratio and was seen as a positive factor for the company's future earnings.
"The shares are likely to stay steady to firmer in wake of its future outlook," said Joyce Leung from Sun Hung Kai Securities.
The shares later retraced to HK$37.60, down 40 cents.
The company said proceeds from the placement would be used to fund its property development and telecommunications activities. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
